declarations.name: Trees.setTree
declarations.syntactic_header: def setTree : BinaryTree α → Set α

declarations.name: Trees.setTree_nil
declarations.syntactic_header: @[simp] theorem setTree_nil : setTree (.nil : BinaryTree α) = ∅

declarations.name: Trees.setTree_node
declarations.syntactic_header:
@[simp] theorem setTree_node (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    setTree (.node a l r) = setTree l ∪ {a} ∪ setTree r

declarations.name: Trees.preorder
declarations.syntactic_header: def preorder : BinaryTree α → List α

declarations.name: Trees.preorder_nil
declarations.syntactic_header: @[simp] theorem preorder_nil : preorder (.nil : BinaryTree α) = []

declarations.name: Trees.preorder_node
declarations.syntactic_header:
@[simp] theorem preorder_node (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    preorder (.node a l r) = a :: (preorder l ++ preorder r)

declarations.name: Trees.mem_inorder_iff_mem_setTree
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem mem_inorder_iff_mem_setTree (x : α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    x ∈ inorder t ↔ x ∈ setTree t

declarations.name: Trees.mem_preorder_iff_mem_setTree
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem mem_preorder_iff_mem_setTree (x : α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    x ∈ preorder t ↔ x ∈ setTree t

declarations.name: Trees.preorder_length
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem preorder_length (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (preorder t).length = t.numNodes

declarations.name: Trees.preorder_map
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem preorder_map (label : α → β) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    preorder (t.map label) = (preorder t).map label

declarations.name: Trees.Subtree
declarations.syntactic_header: inductive Subtree : BinaryTree α → BinaryTree α → Prop

declarations.name: Trees.Subtree.refl
declarations.syntactic_header: (t : BinaryTree α) : Subtree t t

declarations.name: Trees.Subtree.left
declarations.syntactic_header: {s l r : BinaryTree α} (a : α) : Subtree s l → Subtree s (.node a l r)

declarations.name: Trees.Subtree.right
declarations.syntactic_header: {s l r : BinaryTree α} (a : α) : Subtree s r → Subtree s (.node a l r)

declarations.name: Trees.nil_subtree
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem nil_subtree (t : BinaryTree α) : Subtree .nil t

declarations.name: Trees.subtree_nil_iff
declarations.syntactic_header:
@[simp] theorem subtree_nil_iff (s : BinaryTree α) :
    Subtree s .nil ↔ s = .nil

declarations.name: Trees.subtree_node_iff
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem subtree_node_iff (s : BinaryTree α) (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    Subtree s (.node a l r) ↔
      s = .node a l r ∨ Subtree s l ∨ Subtree s r

declarations.name: Trees.Subtree.trans
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem Subtree.trans {s t u : BinaryTree α}
    (hst : Subtree s t) (htu : Subtree t u) : Subtree s u

declarations.name: Trees.subtrees
declarations.syntactic_header: def subtrees (t : BinaryTree α) : Set (BinaryTree α)

declarations.name: Trees.mem_subtrees_iff
declarations.syntactic_header:
@[simp] theorem mem_subtrees_iff {s t : BinaryTree α} :
    s ∈ subtrees t ↔ Subtree s t

declarations.name: Trees.subtrees_nil
declarations.syntactic_header: @[simp] theorem subtrees_nil : subtrees (.nil : BinaryTree α) = {.nil}

declarations.name: Trees.subtrees_node
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem subtrees_node (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    subtrees (.node a l r) = {.node a l r} ∪ subtrees l ∪ subtrees r

declarations.name: Trees.self_mem_subtrees
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem self_mem_subtrees (t : BinaryTree α) : t ∈ subtrees t

declarations.name: Trees.nil_mem_subtrees
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem nil_mem_subtrees (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (.nil : BinaryTree α) ∈ subtrees t

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample
declarations.syntactic_header: def sample : BinaryTree Nat

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_preorder
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_preorder : preorder sample = [9, 3, 7]

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_inorder
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_inorder : inorder sample = [3, 9, 7]

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_setTree
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_setTree : setTree sample = {3, 9, 7}

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_numNodes
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_numNodes : sample.numNodes = 3

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_preorder_length
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_preorder_length : (preorder sample).length = 3

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_contains_seven
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_contains_seven : 7 ∈ setTree sample

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_excludes_eight
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_excludes_eight : 8 ∉ setTree sample

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_constant_map
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem sample_constant_map :
    preorder (sample.map (fun _ : Nat => (5 : Nat))) = [5, 5, 5]

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_left_subtree
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem sample_left_subtree :
    (.node 3 .nil .nil : BinaryTree Nat) ∈ subtrees sample

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.nested_left_subtree
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem nested_left_subtree :
    (.node 3 .nil .nil : BinaryTree Nat) ∈ subtrees (.node 20 sample .nil)

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_has_empty_subtree
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem sample_has_empty_subtree :
    (.nil : BinaryTree Nat) ∈ subtrees sample

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.sample_has_self_subtree
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem sample_has_self_subtree : sample ∈ subtrees sample

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.leftRepeated
declarations.syntactic_header: def leftRepeated : BinaryTree Nat

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.rightRepeated
declarations.syntactic_header: def rightRepeated : BinaryTree Nat

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.repeated_traversals
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem repeated_traversals :
    preorder leftRepeated = [5, 5] ∧ preorder rightRepeated = [5, 5] ∧
      inorder leftRepeated = [5, 5] ∧ inorder rightRepeated = [5, 5]

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.repeated_sets
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem repeated_sets :
    setTree leftRepeated = {5} ∧ setTree rightRepeated = {5}

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.repeated_trees_distinct
declarations.syntactic_header: theorem repeated_trees_distinct : leftRepeated ≠ rightRepeated

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.leftRepeated_not_subtree_rightRepeated
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem leftRepeated_not_subtree_rightRepeated :
    ¬ Subtree leftRepeated rightRepeated

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.same_set_not_subtree
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem same_set_not_subtree :
    setTree leftRepeated = setTree rightRepeated ∧
      ¬ Subtree leftRepeated rightRepeated

declarations.name: TreeBasicObservationsExamples.empty_label_observations
declarations.syntactic_header:
theorem empty_label_observations :
    setTree (.nil : BinaryTree Empty) = ∅ ∧
      preorder (.nil : BinaryTree Empty) = [] ∧
      subtrees (.nil : BinaryTree Empty) = {.nil}
